section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women (N=228, M age=19.89). The study investigated the relation between ethnic identity and body appreciation, finding that ethnic identity was moderately and positively associated with body appreciation, and that Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the relation between ethnic identity and eating, weight, and shape concerns.
